description_for_human: Find the best restaurants, cafes, bars, and attractions in any city — curated from Reddit with Google ratings, insider tips, and what to order.
description_for_model: Search tabiji.ai for AI-curated travel data. Use searchTravel to find destinations, restaurant/bar/cafe picks guides, day-by-day itineraries, and destination comparisons. Then use detail endpoints to get full data including Google ratings, opening hours, Reddit quotes, insider tips, and what to order. All data is editorially curated from Reddit and verified with Google Places. No API key required.
